name: Rolen SyncSkin Chrome-Cover Interface Glove
description:
A slim, five-fingered glove engineered to slip over chrome hand augments and standard biological hands alike, built from a conductive graphene-weave shell with a matte charcoal finish and subtle iridescent threading. The palm is lined with a haptic mesh that reads surface texture and pressure, relaying sensation data directly to a BCI port via a thin cable routed along the dorsal seam to a magnetic snap connector at the wrist.

Fingertips can be individually detached via micro-zipper tabs — useful when the wearer has augmented digits that need direct contact. The glove cosmetically smooths the visual transition between chrome forearm and wrist, making aug-users appear more uniform in professional settings.
functionality: Haptic feedback transmits touch data to BCI. Individual fingertip removal for augmented digits. Chrome-cover profile smooths aug appearance. Magnetic wrist connector compatible with Rolen and most third-party chrome forearm ports.
what_it_says: You have chrome, you have money, and you'd prefer people not stare at the junction line.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 analyst's Rolen glove starts relaying someone else's haptic data — another user on the same BCI mesh frequency, experiencing something terrifying.
A stolen shipment of SyncSkin gloves turns up on the Shelf — modified with a secondary data-logging layer that captures every surface the wearer touches.
related_entities: Axiom Systems BCI-Integrated Mesh Network Protocol

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting glove that bridges biological and augmented hands with seamless professionalism. The graphene weave creates a uniform, almost liquid-metal appearance that catches light subtly. Worn by augmented workers in corporate or medical environments, it reads as refined functionality—neither ostentatiously chromed nor aggressively utilitarian.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tailored, second-skin tight around the palm and fingers. Designed to hug chrome hand augments without bunching, while conforming snugly to biological hands. The wrist section sits just below the forearm, creating a clean transition line.
physical_description.primary_material: Conductive graphene-weave composite with haptic mesh palm lining. Dorsal seam houses a thin signal cable terminating in a magnetic snap connector.
physical_description.texture: Matte charcoal surface with fine iridescent threading visible at certain angles—creates subtle rainbow shimmer across knuckles and palm. The haptic mesh beneath the outer layer feels slightly textured to the touch, almost like fine chainmail.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal gray with embedded iridescent threads that shift from teal to purple in side-lighting. No loud branding—Rolen's logo is a minimal embossed detail on the wrist snap.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap connector at wrist for BCI cable attachment. Individual micro-zipper tabs on each fingertip for modular detachment. No additional fasteners needed—compression fit alone secures the glove.
distinctive_features: Dorsal seam integrating signal cable routed to wrist magnetic snap
Five individually detachable fingertips via micro-zipper tabs
Haptic mesh palm that reads surface texture and pressure
Cosmetic smoothing design to bridge chrome augments with biological wrist
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 boundary: mid-market augment accessory. Affordable enough for working professionals with aug enhancements, premium enough to signal corpo or medical sector affiliation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate augment user, medical technician, skilled tradesperson with cybernetics. The wearer is neither cutting-edge chrome-heavy nor street-salvage—they're integrated into formal or semi-formal augmented work culture. Signals competence and investment in aug-compatible gear.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. The graphene weave resists scuffing; typical wear shows only minor dulling of the iridescent threading from repeated micro-zipper use on fingertips. Kept clean and functional—this is professional equipment.
